subject: Thanks for the help
text:
Thanks again. You helped today. The board read your notes. It helped a lot.

After my earlier reply, I learned more. The budget is approved. The repair date is set. It is the ninth. The team can start then. I wanted you to know. You were a teammate in this. You are still a neighbor first. That matters to me.

Your idea about the ramp worked. The architect liked it. It saved time. It saved money. It made the plan fairer. The parents will be relieved. The older kids can get in safely. That is a real gain.

I know you have your own work. You still answered questions. You stayed calm in the group chat. You helped me explain the delay. That was kind. It gave me room to think.

I will update you before the date. I will not crowd you. If you need details, ask. If you want to sit in, say so. I can arrange it. If you prefer quiet, I can understand. Both options are fine.

You made this easier. People felt better. That helped the outcome. I do not take it for granted. I am glad to have you nearby. I am glad to work with you.

The update felt good. I hope it helps. It lightens my mind. I can focus. I can breathe. I can serve well. You deserve thanks. You deserve credit. I will mention it. I will be fair. I will stay steady.

Rest tonight. Tomorrow will come. I will do the next part. I will keep you posted. Thank you again.
